method: Both complete PNG figures visually inspected using view_image. Text, axes, legends, row/column labels and footnotes readable, with no clipping or overlap. Corresponding PDFs exported from the same figure objects; PDF rendering not separately inspected.
limitations: Native P and full-FFN curves can overlap; exact values remain separate in CSV and numeric appendix. Near-zero calibration values are compressed below the symlog threshold .05, declared on figure.
